def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = sep
    right = w - sep - 1
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(left)]
            for r in range(h)]
